## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` with no errors or warnings
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` is clean
- [ ] Tests for the affected area pass, with a new or updated test covering the change
- [ ] Documentation updated if a contract, use case, requirement or the architecture changed
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or local-only material
- [ ] No AI attribution (co-authors, "generated with" lines) in commits or this description
